title: 03 Regular Employment Contract & Special Forms - Topic Quiz

questions.text: Which characteristic is typical of an employee under a Regular Employment Contract?
options: They carry the full economic risk of the company
They may freely send a third-party substitute at any time
They provide personal labor while bound by instructions
They register themselves independently with the SVS
questions.correctAnswer: They provide personal labor while bound by instructions

questions.text: Who registers the employee for social insurance under a Regular Employment Contract, and with which institution?
options: The employer registers the employee with the OeGK
The employee registers themselves with the OeGK
The employer registers the employee with the SVS
The employee registers themselves with the SVS
questions.correctAnswer: The employer registers the employee with the OeGK

questions.text: How is income tax generally paid under a Regular Employment Contract?
options: The employee must file an independent income tax return
The employer deducts wage tax and remits it to the tax office
No income taxes apply to dependent employment
The OeGK deducts wage tax directly from the employer's account
questions.correctAnswer: The employer deducts wage tax and remits it to the tax office

questions.text: How many hours of mandatory internship must HAK students complete between Year II and before entering Year V?
options: 150 hours during regular school lesson hours
200 hours exclusively during the final school year
400 hours split across two separate companies
300 hours during lesson-free time

questions.text: Amara Hadic works Saturdays at H&M and earns below the marginal earnings threshold per month. Which insurance does her employer cover?
options: Only accident insurance
Health, pension, and unemployment insurance
Only health and pension insurance
No statutory social insurance at all

questions.text: Which entitlements do marginally employed workers have toward their employer?
options: Only the agreed hourly wage with no additional rights
Paid vacation, but neither sick pay nor special payments
Paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments
Only special payments, but no paid vacation entitlement
questions.correctAnswer: Paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments

questions.text: An accountant works daily at a carpentry office using the firm's computer, keeps fixed hours, and follows the owner's instructions. Which contract applies?
options: Freelance Service Contract
Regular Employment Contract
Contract for Work
Marginal Work Order

questions.text: A holiday job is always a Regular Employment Contract with full entitlement to paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments.
In Austria, a Regular Employment Contract is legally valid only if concluded in writing.
Explain the five main traits of an employee under a Regular Employment Contract and name three key statutory entitlements besides wages or salary.
questions.correctAnswer: Five traits: (1) owes personal labor, (2) bound by employer instructions, (3) keeps fixed working hours and workplace, (4) uses employer's work equipment, (5) carries no economic risk. Three key entitlements: paid vacation, sick pay, and special payments (vacation bonus and Christmas bonus).
